			vmem_notice_icon->set_tooltip_text(TTR(R"(Notice:
This tool only reports memory allocations tracked by the engine.
Therefore, total VRAM usage is inaccurate compared to what the Monitors tab or external tools can report.

```suggestion
- Buffer Memory (e.g. GPUParticles) is not tracked.
```

Also, I'm not sure if C++11 raw literals are supported by the translation extractor. We don't have any instances of `TTR(R` in the codebase currently, so probably not. This should most likely be converted to a traditional string with `\n`.

I believe this should also use `TTRC()` instead of `TTR()` to support runtime language changes.

There are 2 instances of `TTR(R"` in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/931820d33cbc38328e4014d65dd62c359b5116fc/editor/editor_audio_buses.cpp#L1399
and https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/8fd71e6b17811cfdd7cc222c97eff4f81edcf4c5/editor/editor_audio_buses.cpp#L1380

But I can still change it to TTRC if needed
Yes, the tooltip should also use TTRC.
